rules.label: Qualified Charity Care Program base eligibility
rules.quote: Patients residing in the BCH service area, receiving medically necessary nonemergent/scheduled hospital services are eligible to apply for the Qualified Charity Care Program.

rules.label: WeCare base eligibility
rules.quote: Patients residing in a BCH service area, receiving medically necessary nonemergent/scheduled hospital services, may apply for WeCare under this policy.

rules.label: Presumptive financial assistance base eligibility
rules.quote: Extraordinary circumstances may result in eligibility for presumptive financial assistance on a case-by-case basis. Some examples include: -Individual is stated/verified to be homeless.

payment_plan.quote: Payment plans that are established to pay the bills may not exceed four (4) percent of the patient's monthly household income.

notes: AGB rate is referenced but not numerically specified in the policy text; see Addendum A for facility-specific percentages.
Excluded services (cosmetic, transplant, research, etc.) are listed in the policy but not encoded in the model due to vocabulary limitations.
Self-pay discounts (20% for physician clinic, 50% for facility charges) are not modeled as financial assistance rules per instructions.
Multiple discounts are not allowed per policy.
MDsave program mentioned but not modeled as it is not a financial assistance discount under FAP.
Homeless individuals are exempt from income documentation requirements for QCCP, WeCare, and HDC.
Applicants must cooperate with documentation requirements; failure to submit within 30-45 days may require updated documentation.
WeCare payment arrangement tiers based on bill amount are not modeled as they pertain to payment plans, not discount eligibility.
Presumptive assistance examples include incarcerated, deceased with no estate, Medicaid eligibility mismatch, crime victims compensation, and out-of-state public program eligibility.
qccp_base may leave out a condition: Missing requirement: applicants must be Colorado residents.
wecare_base may leave out a condition: Missing requirement: applicants must be Colorado residents.
presumptive_base may leave out a condition: Presumptive assistance requires meeting program-specific eligibility beyond homelessness.

dropped.claim: The policy's deadline for a patient to SUBMIT a financial-assistance application is 181 days after the date of service (alone, or as one of several 'the later of' options)
dropped.quote: The date of service (or date of discharge whichever is later) must be within 181 days from the date of applying for the Qualified Charity Care Program.
dropped.why: The 181-day limit applies to service date relative to application date, not application deadline after service.
